title: Google Programmable Search (web search)
description: Google's Custom Search JSON API as gohort's web search, declared as a service: the request and how its results are read are data you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Create a search engine at programmablesearchengine.google.com (its ID is the cx) and an API key for the Custom Search API at console.cloud.google.com. The credential lands disabled: enable it under API Credentials. Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which makes one real search for a common phrase. Then put it to use by choosing it under Admin > Capabilities > Web Search as Service: <name>. No price is declared, as it depends on your plan: add a per_call cost to the connector's spec to see what searches cost.
